release_notes:
## What's New & Fixed

- Replaced the Save, Layouts, Trash, Undo, and Redo toolbar graphics with a matching pure-white icon set.
- Save now uses a folder with a downward arrow.
- Layouts now uses a clean open-folder symbol.
- Trash now uses the requested solid bin design.
- Undo and Redo are exact mirrored versions of the same curved arrow.
- Normalized all five graphics to transparent 128x128 PNG resources with consistent padding and visible size.
